description: Chimney goblin back a second time; Thatch & Sons quoted $620 for a goblin-proof chimney cap
body: The goblin came back and took the oven mitts. Old Man Thatch came round and quoted $620 for a goblin-proof brass chimney cap, fitted in August.

description: Sir Fluffington caught a moth and singed the lampshade
body: He caught a moth in mid-air and singed the reading-nook lampshade doing it. Lampshade survives.
